Secure your seat among the elite in this exclusive side event—perfect for competitive Riftbound players looking to upgrade their home setup. Undefeated competitors will each be awarded a Secretlab TITAN Evo League of Legends Edition chair of their choice. Event cap is 1024 players. Competitors will play 1v1 Constructed. This event requires a decklist submission. 6 Rounds. Best of 3. Rounds have a 60 minute time limit. Prizes are awarded by the end of Round 6. Prize Conditions & Eligibility: Chair prizes are available to participants based in the US, EU, UK, SG, and MY. Please note that fulfillment may not be available to certain states and rural areas. Styles and sizes are subject to regional availability. You can view the current options for your region at secretlab.co/leagueoflegends , though stock may vary at the time of prize redemption. Within a week following the event, a Secretlab representative will contact the winners directly to confirm their preferred design and size, as well as their delivery details to fulfill the prize. Players residing outside of the eligible regions are still welcome to compete. Should an ineligible player finish with a perfect record, they will receive a Secretlab Lumbar Pillow League of Legends Edition and a Standard Competitor badge for a future Regional Qualifier in lieu of the physical chair prize.
